short_description: Find and verify installable Agent Skills.
description: Discover current Agent Skills from public repositories and compare their provenance, compatibility, licensing, and verified install paths.

requires: Network access or an authorized repository-search tool
An authorized SandBase connection only when SandBase search or scraping is used

install.prompt: Use $internet-skill-finder to find and verify Agent Skills for this task.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill internet-skill-finder --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill internet-skill-finder --agent codex --global

examples: Find a maintained Skill for browser accessibility testing.
Compare three public Agent Skills for spreadsheet analysis and disclose their licenses.
Verify this repository's SKILL.md and give me the correct installation command.

optional_inputs: authorized SandBase connection for web search and extraction

notes: Search results are treated as untrusted leads until the canonical repository is inspected.
The Skill does not install a recommendation without an explicit request.
No frozen repository list, star count, endpoint, or Manus import URL is used.

endpoints.summary: Discover current web-search, repository-search, and page-extraction capabilities.
Inspect live schemas, coverage, limits, and pricing.
Execute a user-approved search or page extraction.
Poll an asynchronous search or extraction run.
Recover recent run status and observed cost.
Check balance before an approved search or extraction batch.
